source_recommendations_md_note: SOURCE-RECOMMENDATIONS.md was deliberately withheld during the first pass to prevent anchoring on Sol's preferred packages and numeric scores. source_recommendations_review.rubric_assessment: The ranking method is sound and auditable: ten criteria (Authority, Provenance, Semantic challenge, Failure-mode fit, Reproducibility, Accessibility, Licensing practicality, Corpus size/cost, low Noise, Independence), scored 1-5, deliberately unweighted so authority cannot mask an access or licensing failure, with the explicit caveat that low licensing scores are not waivers. The criticism that the ranking was unauditable is withdrawn and blocker B15 is closed.
rubric_blind_spots: No criterion scores whether the source text is machine-usable. C12-A scores accessibility 4 and reproducibility 3, which is defensible if only the collection page was opened; opening the files shows the 1906 law has zero extractable characters and the 1907 file yields 618 words of glyph fragments. This supports proposed requirement R13 and motivates a new criterion T (text usability), scored only after opening the file.

No criterion scores fit against implemented capability. C05-A scores Failure-mode fit 5; the fit is perfect against the documented product and impossible against the running system, since M8 is not implemented. Add a criterion or a hard precondition that a stage exists which can exhibit the measured behaviour.

No criterion penalises ingesting a verification scan as a corpus source. C01-A scores 50/50 with Provenance 5 while listing both the Gutenberg transcript and the LoC scan as package sources. This is why proposed requirement R14 is needed.

cross_cutting_findings.title: Multi-source semantic reconciliation is not implemented
cross_cutting_findings.evidence: ClaimReconcilerService.reconcile() is scoped to a single source_id and receives only that source's evidence_items; DisagreementGraphBuilder emits nodes only from agreeing_source_ids/disagreeing_source_ids or CONTESTED status, which single-source reconciliation cannot populate with valid foreign UUIDs; STATUS.md line 64 states 'M8 Full multi-source semantic reconciliation: not implemented'.
cross_cutting_findings.consequence: Cases whose target failure mode is cross-source disagreement cannot distinguish model failure from an absent architectural stage.

cross_cutting_findings.title: C12 primary texts are machine-unusable and one is the wrong document
cross_cutting_findings.evidence: Local inspection of both Iran Data Portal PDFs. 1906: 12 pages, 0 extractable characters, 12 embedded images (pure image scan). 1907: 26 pages, 3058 characters, 618 words, 626 NUL bytes, 1453 Arabic presentation-form characters, article bodies do not extract. Normalized 1907 text contains پهلوي, قاجاريه and ولايتعهد, indicating a consolidated text carrying the 1925 Pahlavi amendment.
cross_cutting_findings.consequence: Would force Persian OCR into a benchmark that excludes OCR, would break evidence_validator verbatim excerpt matching, and would ground gold atoms in a document of the wrong vintage.

cross_cutting_findings.title: C09 measures the deterministic extraction planner, not long-range reasoning
cross_cutting_findings.evidence: plan_evidence_extraction caps selection at min(total, coverage*1.1, max(12000, min(180000, duration*1800))). Darwin 1859 is ~150k words ~ 200k tokens; at 40 minutes the budget is 72000 tokens, about 36 percent of the book, with the remainder deferred by design.
cross_cutting_findings.consequence: The declared failure mode 'sampling masquerading as full coverage' is guaranteed to trip on every run because of fixed code.

cross_cutting_findings.title: Holdout designs are already public
cross_cutting_findings.evidence: CASE-MATRIX.md commits each holdout's Research Brief, source package, capability, and explicit 'Failures exposed' list to git history.
cross_cutting_findings.consequence: Withholding gold atoms later does not restore holdout value; H13/H14/H15 must be treated as core-visible.

cross_cutting_findings.title: Source roles and filenames do not reach the semantic prompts; in-document headings do
cross_cutting_findings.evidence: coverage_audit/1.0.0/user.md and episode_plan/1.1.0/user.md receive briefs, claims, priorities and IDs only; claims carry source_id UUIDs. evidence_extraction/1.3.0/user.md receives the block JSON including heading_path.
cross_cutting_findings.consequence: Role-based gaming is impossible via filenames or source metadata; the real leakage vector is the document's own headings and front matter.

cross_cutting_findings.title: The eval harness has no source triage stage
cross_cutting_findings.evidence: eval_harness._run_case ingests every configured source and calls analyze_source on all of them; uploaded sources are registered full_text + include.
cross_cutting_findings.consequence: C08 measures claim-level relevance at prioritisation and planning, not source triage. Its failures will be misread if described as triage.

proposed_replacement_packages.verified: PG #11224 confirmed: title Utilitarianism, Mill (1806-1873), released 2004-02-01, last updated 2024-10-28, public domain in the USA, available as plain-text UTF-8 (179 kB) and HTML. Born-digital, no OCR, passes R13 by construction. Chapter II is an explicit sequence of objections stated in the objector's voice and then answered.
proposed_replacement_packages.why_it_fits: The target failure - attributing a stated objection to Mill as his own position - is measurable today and entirely single-source: the document mapper assigns objection and response section functions, ClaimType.COUNTERARGUMENT exists alongside AUTHOR_POSITION, and the reconciler is explicitly forbidden to merge an objection with its response or convert criticism into an author position. No M8 dependency.
proposed_replacement_packages.why_no_overlap_with_C09: Different source, author, domain (moral philosophy vs natural science) and failure mode: C09 tests long-range prerequisite ordering across a long monograph; C05R tests dense, local, high-frequency dialectical voice attribution in a short text.
proposed_replacement_packages.scope_and_cost: Whole book about 30k words ~ 40k tokens. At 25 minutes (standard tier): target = min(40000, 26400, 45000) = 26400 tokens, 66 percent coverage. Mid-sized and cheap.
proposed_replacement_packages.declared_residual_overlap: Shares a claim-typing family with C03 (Woolf): rhetorical-device typing vs dialectical voice attribution. Different specific distinction, shared family. Recorded rather than hidden.
outstanding: Author the brief and pin scope plus output configuration (R15).

binding_constraints: Single-source or otherwise M8-independent: no holdout may depend on unimplemented capability.
Must pass R13 including a pinned revision or edition.
Must be commit_safe or private_fixture with a documented acquisition procedure, so release runs can actually execute.
No source, author, publisher or corpus reused from any visible case, or the holdout inherits visible-set tuning.
Sized for cost: none should exceed the median visible-case corpus.

may_contain: opaque case_id carrying no semantic hint (e.g. HS-A1)
public_manifest.auditability_note: The slot SET is public; the MAPPING from slot to case ID stays private, so coverage is auditable without revealing what any given holdout tests.

execution_architecture: Holdout design and gold live in a private git submodule at benchmarks/eval/holdout/; the public repo commits only the submodule pointer. One .gitmodules entry, no new infrastructure, provenance stays version-controlled.

thesisound eval --split core (default) and --split all; all requires THESISOUND_HOLDOUT_PATH. When the bundle is absent, holdout gates report skipped, never pass - reusing the convention evaluate_gates already implements for unknown cost.
Run holdouts on release tags only, with the bundle mounted from a CI secret. Publish per-case pass/fail and gate status only. Never publish per-atom diffs - that is the leak channel.
Rotation: a holdout is partly consumed the first time its failures are debugged. Budget one rotation per release cycle and keep at least one reserve case designed but unreferenced.
A CONTRIBUTING note that prompt changes must not be authored while reading holdout outputs. Unenforceable alone, which is why the diff-withholding rule matters.

dataset_level_cautions: Victorian-prose concentration: C01 (James), C03 (Woolf), C05R (Mill) and C09 (Darwin) are four of twelve core cases in nineteenth-century English prose. Domains differ, register does not, so a regression in archaic-English handling would hit four cases at once and the failures would be correlated, reducing effective information. No fifth Victorian text should be added.
Persian coverage rests on C02 and V15 only. Both carry outstanding verification work, which is why the C02 R13 check is blocking.
V13 overlaps C06 and is the first candidate for removal on cost grounds.
Suite is a release gate, not a per-PR check: evidence extraction runs one model call per selected block, so call count is the cost driver.
Several cases are manifest_or_excerpt or private_fixture, so a public CI run cannot acquire them; without a private fixture store those gates will silently degrade to skipped.
dataset_level.ready_for_source_freeze_reason: The set is now structurally sound: 12 visible core with no case measuring an unimplemented subsystem, no case depending on an unusable file, a duration pair inside the product contract, and a holdout architecture that can actually hold something back. What remains is execution: one source swap with human collation, one blocking text-usability check, one acquisition, several brief rewrites, and a licence pass.
dataset_level.stop_condition_observed: No source frozen, no hashes created, no gold authored.

preferred_package_agreement.note: Two models working separately from the same candidate pool converged on the same preferred package in every case. No case exists where I preferred one of Sol's alternates. Every divergence is about whether the agreed package is usable, or about scope and brief repair - never about which candidate ranks first.

reconciliation.rubric_assessment: Sound and auditable: ten criteria (Authority, Provenance, Semantic challenge, Failure-mode fit, stable Reproducibility, Accessibility, Licensing practicality, Corpus size/cost, low Noise, Independence), scored 1-5, deliberately unweighted so a high-authority source cannot hide an access or licensing failure, with the explicit caveat that low licensing scores are not waivers. Better designed than I assumed in its absence. Blocker B15 withdrawn.

rubric_blind_spots.gap: No criterion scores whether the source text is machine-usable; Accessibility scores whether the file is obtainable, not whether it parses.
rubric_blind_spots.evidence: C12-A scores Accessibility 4 and Reproducibility 3, defensible if only the collection page was opened; opening the files shows 0 extractable characters (1906) and 618 words of glyph fragments (1907).
rubric_blind_spots.supports: R13, plus a new criterion T (text usability) scored only after opening the file

rubric_blind_spots.evidence: C05-A scores Failure-mode fit 5. The fit is perfect against the documentation and impossible against the running system.

reconciliation.pattern: Sol's objections are accurate wherever they rest on bibliographic reasoning and miss wherever the answer required opening a file or reading the pipeline code. All four of my cross-cutting findings fall in the second category. Sol also stated the core risk for C03, C04, C07, C08, C10, H13 and H15 - the diagnostic instinct was largely right; what was missing was the step from naming a risk to acting on it, which shows most sharply at C04 where the risk is stated and confidence is still High.

duration_pair_decision.question: Does a 20/40 pair replace the Phase-1 5/30 pair?
duration_pair_decision.basis: MVP product contract defines output as a 20-40 minute private episode. 5 minutes is outside it. Retained nothing merely because Phase 1 proposed it.
duration_pair_decision.key_implementation_finding: 30 and 40 minutes produce an IDENTICAL analysis profile - both fall in the deep tier (26-45), so the extraction stage cannot distinguish them. The entire depth contrast in a 20/40 pair comes from the 20-minute member crossing into standard. Choosing 40 over 30 affects only the episode and script stage: a harder supported-duration bar (32 vs 24) and 33 percent more script.

levers_preserved.block_coverage_target: 0.60 -> 0.85, achieved 66% -> 93.5%, a 27.5 percentage-point spread (narrower than 5/30 but substantial)

duration_pair_decision.lever_lost: include_examples no longer contrasts (True in both members). The least consequential of the four; documented and accepted.

supportability_of_40_minutes.evidence_density_gate: 40 x 20 = 800 tokens required; corpus carries about 21000; 26x margin
supportability_of_40_minutes.claim_time_gate: 600 claim-seconds required; a deep run over ~40 blocks at up to 5 claims per block yields far more; per-claim floor is 15s
supportability_of_40_minutes.can_plan_episode: requires model-reported max_supported_minutes >= 32; deterministic estimator will report well over 100
supportability_of_40_minutes.output_ratio: 5200 Persian words at 130 wpm from about 15000 source words, with explanation_expansion_factor 4.0 encoding that claim time expands; comfortably selection-and-explanation, not padding

duration_pair_decision.bonus: 20 and 40 are the endpoints of the MVP output band, so the pair now validates the contract range directly. 5/30 never did.
duration_pair_decision.pinning_requirement: Corpus, brief text, modes, prior_knowledge, audience and output_language must be pinned IDENTICALLY. A stray critical/debate mode (+10pp coverage) or advanced prior_knowledge (+1 claim, +1 neighbour) voids the control.
duration_pair_decision.resolves_sol_objection: Sol's C10 objection that a five-minute brief may force omissions reviewers consider essential, making gold brittle, is resolved by this change.

r13_validation_procedure.when: Once per fixture file, before freezing
r13_validation_procedure.output: text-usability.json committed beside the source manifest
r13_validation_procedure.principle: Every gate is fail-closed: a fixture that cannot be measured is rejected, never assumed clean.

steps.name: Extract through the production path
steps.detail: Use the repo parser route (thesisound parse --parser auto), not an ad-hoc tool, so the check measures what the pipeline will actually see.

steps.name: Record the raw profile
steps.detail: Page count, extractable characters, words, embedded image count, characters per page.

steps.name: Text presence
steps.detail: Reject if extractable characters are approximately 0, or characters-per-page falls below a prose floor (about 800 for body text).
steps.retrospective: Rejects the C12 1906 file: 0 characters across 12 pages, 12 embedded images.

steps.name: Encoding sanity
steps.detail: Reject on any of: NUL (U+0000) present; characters in Arabic Presentation Forms-A (U+FB50-U+FDFF) or Forms-B (U+FE70-U+FEFF), which indicate glyph-level encoding with no proper Unicode mapping; Private Use Area characters (U+E000-U+F8FF); replacement character U+FFFD count greater than 0.
steps.retrospective: Rejects the C12 1907 file: 626 NULs and 1453 presentation-form characters.

steps.name: Persian-specific checks
steps.detail: Mirroring document_identity.py normalisation. Script ratio: at least 95 percent of letters in the Arabic block (U+0600-U+06FF) for Persian fixtures. Letter forms: record counts of Persian ی (U+06CC) and ک (U+06A9) versus Arabic ي (U+064A) and ك (U+0643); mixed forms are not fatal but must be normalised consistently and counted. ZWNJ: record U+200C count - zero ZWNJ in a long Persian text is a red flag for lossy extraction. Digits: record Persian/Arabic-Indic versus ASCII mix. Bidi sanity: confirm embedded Latin and numeric runs are not reversed.

steps.name: Round-trip excerpt matching (decisive)
steps.detail: Sample N=20 random 40-character spans from the extracted text and verify each matches verbatim in the parsed block text after whitespace normalisation, using the repo excerpt_matching / evidence_validator normalisation. Any failure rejects the fixture.
steps.why: This is what production enforces. A source that fails here would make evidence_validator block every claim, so the case would appear to fail semantically while actually failing on encoding.

steps.name: Human spot-check
steps.detail: A reader fluent in the fixture language confirms three randomly chosen pages read correctly and reading order is right (RTL/LTR mixing, footnote interleaving, table and verse layout). Required for all Persian fixtures and for any English fixture whose Gate A-D margins are thin.

steps.name: Identity pinning
steps.detail: Compute and record parsed_document_key and block_sequence_key so the fixture is pinned and later drift is detectable.

steps.name: Provenance record
steps.detail: Record source edition, publication year, retrieval URL and date, retrieval HTTP status, and for wiki-hosted transcriptions the exact revision ID. A mutable source without a pinned revision fails R13 regardless of text quality.
